table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode,    
		 srinvcode = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,    
       date = dbo.srledger.date,   
       invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc,    
       flatdisc = dbo.srledger.flatdisc,    
       misccharges = dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.srledger.salestax,
		 CustRefNo   = dbo.srledger.CustRefNo,
		 remarks     = dbo.srledger.Remarks,
		 looseqty = dbo.srdetail.looseqty, 
		 packing=case
						when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) 
						else dbo.itempacking.name
					end,
       itemflatdisc= 0,
       packqty  = srdetail.packqty,  
       price = dbo.srdetail.saleprice,    
       itemdiscperc = dbo.srdetail.discperc,    
		 packunits = dbo.srdetail.packunits,    
		 batch = dbo.srdetail.batch,    
		 expiry = dbo.srdetail.expiry,    
		 salestax  = srdetail.salestax,
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, srledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, srledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, srledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name,
       patient=(select name from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode),
		 regno = (select regno from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode)

FROM 	 
	dbo.srledger, 
	dbo.srdetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON ( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  dbo.srledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		 dbo.srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
/*		 dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (6, 7, 8) and */
		 dbo.srledger.patientcode=:ai_patientcode and
		 dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
		 dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode

objects.name: t_12
objects.text: Customer Site Wise Daily Sale Return Detail

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum((((  looseqty   *  price  )  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ))  *  invdiscperc  * 0.01 for all)

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(   c_amount  for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct srinvcode ) - sum( flatdisc  for all distinct srinvcode) -   compute_4 , 0)

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum( misccharges for all Distinct   srinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  srinvcode  )  +  compute_4

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  ) )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ), 2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round (Sum(((  looseqty   *  price  ) )  *  ( 1 - (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2) *  ( 1 - invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)
